sloka: पितुस्तु मम जामाता विष्णुः किल सुरेश्वरः ।अभिप्रेतस्त्रिलोकेशस्तस्मान्नान्यस्य मे पिता ।। ७.१७.१२ ॥
transliteration: pitustu mama jāmātā viṣṇuḥ kila sureśvaraḥ ।abhipretastrilokeśastasmānnānyasya me pitā ।। 7.17.12 ॥

translations.english: But that father of mine did not give me to them, O best of Rakshasas; I will now tell you the reason for that, O night-wanderer, so listen.
